title: lem-pc-closed-structure-tensor-complex-projection
statement: Let i:Z→Y be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme], assume the recorded tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] is additive, and let P be any integer-indexed cochain complex of O_Y-module sheaves [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. Put B=i_*O_Z and T=i^*P termwise. The total tensor complex Tot(P tensor B[0]) is isomorphic as an ordinary cochain complex to i_*T termwise. No resolution, K-flatness or derived category hypothesis is assumed.

proof.text: Apply mapBifunctorSingle₂Iso to replace the total tensor with B[0] by termwise tensorRight B. Lift the ordinary projection natural isomorphism to complexes, then use mapHomologicalComplexCompIso to identify the composite with successive termwise pullback and pushforward.

theorem nonempty_closedStructure_tensor_complex_projection
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [(Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).Additive]
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringCatSheaf) ℤ) :
    letI : MonoidalCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringCatSheaf) :=
      SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory Y.sheaf
    let B := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)
    let T := ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
    Nonempty (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P
      ((HomologicalComplex.single (SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringCatSheaf) (.up ℤ) 0).obj B)
      (curriedTensor _) ≅
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj T)
